name: SHOC2 leucine rich repeat scaffold protein
pathways: positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction

function.text: SHOC2 encodes leucine-rich repeat protein SHOC-2. Annotated molecular activities include protein phosphatase regulator activity and protein phosphatase binding. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Noonan syndrome-like disorder with loose anagen hair (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome-like disorder with loose anagen hair 1 (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
